Alternative experiments of subsets in ExperimentSubset objects

Source: R/ExperimentSubset.R, R/SubsetSingleCellExperiment.R, R/SubsetSpatialExperiment.R, and 1 more
ExperimentSubset-altExp.Rd

Get or set the alternative experiments (altExps) of a subset by naming it with subsetName. Without subsetName, these methods act on the main object, as for SingleCellExperiment. They exist for the classes that extend SingleCellExperiment: SubsetSingleCellExperiment, SubsetSpatialExperiment and SubsetTreeSummarizedExperiment.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment,character'
altExp(x, e, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment,missing'
altExp(x, e, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment,numeric'
altExp(x, e, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment'
altExps(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment'
altExpNames(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment,character'
altExpNames(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment,ANY'
altExpNames(x, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment,character'
altExp(x, e, withDimnames = TRUE, withColData = FALSE, ...) <- value

# S4 method for class 'SubsetSingleCellExperiment,missing'
altExp(x, e, withDimnames = TRUE, withColData = FALSE, ...) <- value

Arguments

x

An ExperimentSubset object.

e

character(1) or integer(1) The name or position of the alternative experiment. Leave it out for the first one. With subsetName, positions follow altExpNames().

...
subsetName

character(1) Name of the subset whose alternative experiments to get or set. Leave it out for the main object's.

unlink

For altExp<- and altExps<- with subsetName: TRUE, FALSE or a character vector of "altExpName/assayName" names. Store assays of value that have the name of a linked altExp assay but different values: with TRUE, every such assay; with names, only those. Any other such assay is an error, and nothing is stored. A message names each assay that is unlinked. Default FALSE. Any other value is an error without subsetName.

Other arguments are passed on to the SingleCellExperiment method. With subsetName, altExpNames() and altExpNames<- ignore other arguments.

value

For altExp<-, a SummarizedExperiment with one column per column of the subset (or of the main object). For altExps<-, a list of them. For altExpNames<-, a character vector of new names, one for each name altExpNames() returns; with subsetName, they must all differ, and only the subset's own altExps can get new names.

withDimnames

logical(1) Passed on to altExp<- or altExps<-. Default TRUE.

withColData

logical(1) Passed on to altExp<- or altExps<-. Default FALSE.

Value

altExp() returns a SummarizedExperiment, altExps() a list of them and altExpNames() a character vector. With subsetName, these are every altExp the subset sees: the main object's first, then those stored only on subsets. The setters return x with the change made.

Details

A subset sees the main object's altExps, and those stored on the subsets it was made from, cut to its own columns (cells). Their rows (features, such as the proteins of an ADT altExp) are not cut: a subset's rows pick features of the main object only. These altExps are linked, as assays are: the subset sees their current values, and stores only what it changes.

Storing an altExp in a subset with altExp<- or altExps<- compares it with the linked one of the same name, assay by assay:

  • A new assay is stored as the subset's own, and the linked assays stay linked.

  • An assay with the values of the linked one is not stored.

  • An assay with other values than the linked one needs unlink, named as "altExpName/assayName", such as "ADT/counts".

  • rowData, colData, metadata and reducedDims are stored when they differ from the linked altExp's, and then replace them whole. An empty one shows the linked one, so a subset can't clear them. Other parts, such as the altExp's own altExps, colPairs and rowPairs, always come from the linked altExp.

  • An assay the subset already stores itself, after an unlink, is not linked, so storing it again needs no unlink.

  • An altExp with other rows, rownames or class than the linked one replaces it entirely, so every linked assay counts as changed. It keeps replacing it for as long as the subset stores it, even if the linked altExp later has the same rows, and so does an altExp a subset stores while nothing of that name is linked. To add to the linked altExp instead, remove the subset's with altExp(x, e, subsetName = s) <- NULL and store it again.

A subset can't remove or rename a linked altExp, or give one of its own the name of another altExp it sees: an altExp missing from value in altExps<- stays visible, and altExp(x, e, subsetName = s) <- NULL removes only what the subset stores, so the linked altExp shows again.

Changes to a linked altExp carry along to the subsets below it, made from the main object or from the subset that stores it. Its new values show in them. Renaming it renames what they store of it. Removing it, or storing it with other rows or another class, drops what they added to it, with a warning; an altExp a subset stores whole is kept.

See also

altExps

Examples

# an object with 10 genes and 20 cells
set.seed(1)
counts <- matrix(rpois(200, lambda = 5), nrow = 10)
rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", 1:10)
colnames(counts) <- paste0("cell", 1:20)
es <- ExperimentSubset(list(counts = counts))
# counts of 2 proteins in the same 20 cells, as an altExp
adtCounts <- matrix(rpois(40, lambda = 20), nrow = 2)
rownames(adtCounts) <- c("CD3", "CD4")
altExp(es, "ADT") <- SummarizedExperiment(list(counts = adtCounts))
#> Warning: 'colnames(value)' are not the same as 'colnames(x)' for 'altExp<-'.
#> This will be an error in the next release of Bioconductor.
# a subset of the first 5 genes and the first 8 cells
es <- createSubset(es, subsetName = "first", rows = 1:5, cols = 1:8)
# the subset sees ADT for its 8 cells, with both proteins
altExpNames(es, subsetName = "first")
#> [1] "ADT"
adt <- altExp(es, "ADT", subsetName = "first")
dim(adt)
#> [1] 2 8
# add an assay to ADT in the subset only; ADT's counts stay linked
assay(adt, "logcounts") <- log1p(assay(adt, "counts"))
altExp(es, "ADT", subsetName = "first") <- adt
assayNames(altExp(es, "ADT", subsetName = "first"))
#> [1] "counts"    "logcounts"
assayNames(altExp(es, "ADT"))
#> [1] "counts"
# a changed linked assay needs unlink
assay(adt, "counts") <- assay(adt, "counts") + 1L
altExp(es, "ADT", subsetName = "first", unlink = "ADT/counts") <- adt
#> Subset 'first' now stores its own 'ADT/counts', unlinked from the main altExp 'ADT'.
